title: Pick a Die. I’ll Pick Second.
description:
Four dice. Higher number wins. You choose first; I choose second.

Look at the faces before you decide. Would first choice really give you the edge?

Original mathematical animation. AI-generated narration.
Mathematical reference: Wolfram MathWorld.
https://mathworld.wolfram.com/EfronsDice.html

#Magnivis #MathPuzzle #Probability
